2609.28245.title: Beyond Poetry: Can Large Language Models Generate Classical Arabic Maqamat?
2609.28245.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in creative text generation, yet their ability to produce culturally grounded and stylistically constrained literary forms remains underexplored. Prior work has focused largely on modern language varieties and poetry, while classical prose traditions such as maqama remain largely unstudied. The maqama is a classical literary genre characterized by rhymed prose (saj), dense rhetorical ornamentation, and episodic narrative structure, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating whether LLMs can move beyond surface fluency toward deeper literary competence. In this paper, we present the first controlled evaluation study of maqama generation with LLMs, comparing five models under zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based prompting, and evaluating outputs through both human annotation and an LLM-as-a-judge framework across dimensions such as rhetorical richness, saj density, structural coherence, and stylistic authenticity. Our results show that prompting strategy plays a strong role in stylistic quality: few-shot prompting most consistently improves saj density, while its effects on rhetoric and coherence vary by model, with the strongest models (GPT-4o and GPT-5.4-mini) benefiting most from rule-based prompting on these dimensions, though zero-shot prompting yields the highest aggregate scores across all five models. We further observe systematic differences between models in stylistic alignment with Arabic maqama conventions, and corroborate our findings with a second independent LLM judge, paired statistical significance testing, and non-LLM proxy measures of saj.
2609.28245.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在創意文本生成方面表現出色，但它們在產生具有文化根基和風格約束的文學形式方面的能力仍然未被充分探索。先前的研究主要集中在現代語言變體和詩歌上，而古典散文傳統如maqama則仍然未被深入研究。maqama是一種古典文學類型，其特徵是押韻散文（saj）、密集的修辭裝飾和情節性敘事結構，使其成為評估LLMs是否能超越表面流暢性，朝向更深層文學能力的挑戰性測試平台。在本文中，我們呈現了首個針對LLMs生成maqama的受控評估研究，比較了在零樣本、少樣本和基於規則的提示下的五個模型，並通過人類標註和LLM作為評判框架在修辭豐富性、saj密度、結構一致性和風格真實性等維度上評估輸出。我們的結果顯示，提示策略在風格質量中起著重要作用：少樣本提示最一致地提高了saj密度，而其對修辭和一致性的影響因模型而異，最強的模型（GPT-4o和GPT-5.4-mini）在這些維度上最受益於基於規則的提示，儘管零樣本提示在所有五個模型中獲得了最高的總體分數。我們進一步觀察到模型在與阿拉伯maqama慣例的風格對齊方面存在系統性差異，並通過第二個獨立的LLM評判者、配對統計顯著性檢測和非LLM的saj代理測量來證實我們的發現。
2609.28245.author: AbdulRahman A. Morsy et.al.
